description: Shows a map folder's page on /atlas:board: one server per map folder, started as a child of the first session that asks and beaten by every session that shows it, joined by the others, taken over when it ends, gone with its session or a minute after the last beat; ends this session's boards on /atlas:stop; hands the page's selection to the next prompt's context; registers the agent's tools atlas_open_points, atlas_reply, atlas_query and atlas_check
